payload.subject: The bot that answers your DMs while you sleep
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most independent service-based businesses only answer DMs when someone happens to be at their desk — and by the time they reply, the lead has already messaged three other options.


An AI chatbot in your DMs changes that. It answers instantly, qualifies the lead, and books the call straight onto your calendar — no missed messages, no forgotten follow-ups. 64% of small businesses plan to deploy a chatbot by 2026, and the ones already running one are seeing it pay off: one service business automated its booking and FAQs and saw 40% more bookings while cutting admin time by 15 hours a week. Across AI-powered customer response tools generally, businesses are seeing $3.50 back for every $1 spent. For {{business_name}}, that's the difference between a lead who goes cold overnight and one who's already on your calendar before you wake up.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call.


Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth
